chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Closeness to his mother and her support
summary: He was extremely close to his mother, less to his father; she was not a performer but was always in his corner.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Were you close with your mother?
Oh, yeah, was I? I couldn't get no closer. Could have almost went to the cemetary with her really.
We were all right. I wasn't as close to him as I was to my mother.
Did she inspire you in any way as a performer?

Oh, yeah, helped me to do anything I wanted to do. She was always in my corner. Beautiful mother. Beautiful mother. Where she came from I don't know. You know, with heart, feeling. She was something else. Anyway, I appreciated both of them. Both of them. My father and my mother.
Your mother wasn't a singer, though, was she?
That seems to be, yeah. My every whim, my everything, she was my everything.
